title: Total lipid content analysis for coral samples
author: Keyla Plichon

steps.title: Dehydrate Coral Subsamples
steps.instruction: Prepare and freeze-dry the coral subsamples.

substeps.instruction: Keep samples in liquid nitrogen and cut a 1 cm² subsample using a mortar and pestle without grinding.
Rinse the subsample in MilliQ water for 5 minutes to remove salts.
Place the subsample in a freeze-drying vial and return to the freezer.
Load subsamples into the freeze dryer, start the vacuum, and let them dry overnight.
Remove subsamples from the freeze dryer, quickly tighten screw caps to avoid moisture, and store at -80°C until analysis.

steps.title: Prepare Daily Reagents and Standards
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary solvent stocks, standard ranges, and purification solutions.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 2 mg/ml cholesterol stock solution in extraction solvent and dilute to create a standard range of 0, 0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 1.25, and 1.5 mg/mL.
Prepare extraction solvent: 2:1 (v/v) chloroform:methanol + 50 mg/L butylated hydroxytoluene (BHT).
Prepare stock containers of 100% chloroform and 100% methanol.
Prepare a 0.88% potassium chloride (KCl) solution by dissolving KCl powder in Milli-Q water.

steps.title: Extract Lipids
steps.instruction: Extract lipids from the freeze-dried coral samples.

substeps.instruction: Pour 10 mL of the chloroform:methanol solution into the glass extraction vial containing the sample and record the time.
Sonicate five times for 10s each, keeping the vial on ice and pausing between cycles to prevent overheating.
Store the vial in the dark at room temperature for one hour.

steps.title: Filter and Collect Lipid Extract
steps.instruction: Separate the lipid extract from the sample residue.

substeps.instruction: Pour the supernatant into a glass centrifuge tube.
Use a glass syringe to dispense 2 mL of extraction solvent into the extraction vial to collect remaining lipids, then pour this rinse into the centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 3000 rpm for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Pour the lipid extract into a clean glass vial or separatory funnel.

steps.title: Purify Lipid Extracts
steps.instruction: Purify the extract using a separatory funnel and KCl solution.

substeps.instruction: Pour the extract into a separatory funnel with the stopcock closed.
Add 4 mL of 0.88% KCl solution, stopper the funnel, and gently invert three times while releasing pressure.
Remove the stopper and drain the lower organic phase into a pre-weighed clean vial, ensuring the aqueous (white) phase does not pass.
Rinse the remaining aqueous phase with 1 mL of 100% chloroform and repeat the purification step.

steps.title: Finalize Organic Phase and Evaporate
steps.instruction: Ensure the extract is transparent and remove the solvent.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 100% methanol to the organic phase; add an additional 1 mL if the extract is not transparent.
Leave the vial under the hood overnight to evaporate the solvent at 37°C to 40°C.

steps.title: Prepare Colorimetric Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the acid and vanillin solutions for the assay.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 17% phosphoric acid by diluting concentrated (100% or 80%) phosphoric acid in Milli-Q water.
Prepare a 0.2 mg/mL vanillin reagent by diluting vanillin in the 17% phosphoric acid solution.
Prepare a stock of concentrated (100%) sulfuric acid and keep a small amount at room temperature.

steps.title: Resuspend and Prepare Samples
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried lipids and prepare them for the reaction.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 mL of extraction solvent to the vial containing the dried lipids.
Pour 150 μL of sample or standard into clean glass tubes (two per sample for duplicates).
Evaporate the solvent in a water bath at 90°C for 30 min.

steps.title: Perform Colorimetric Reaction
steps.instruction: React the lipids with sulfuric acid and vanillin reagent.

substeps.instruction: Cool tubes on ice for 5 minutes.
Add 150 μL of sulfuric acid and place in a water bath at 90°C for 20 min.
Place tubes in an ice bath for 2 min.
Add 50 μL of vanillin-phosphoric acid solution to each well.
Incubate at 37°C for 15 min.

steps.title: Measure Absorbance
steps.instruction: Quantify the lipid content via spectrophotometry.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 100 μL of each sample into a 96-well plate (measures performed in triplicates).
Mix samples and measure absorbance at 540 nm.

steps.title: Normalize by Surface Area
steps.instruction: Determine the surface area of the sample to normalize lipid content.

substeps.instruction: Create a standard curve by weighing aluminum pieces of known surfaces using a balance accurate to 4 decimal places.
Cover the skeleton surface that was previously covered by animal tissue with aluminum pieces.
Weigh the aluminum pieces and use the standard curve to determine the corresponding surface area.
Divide the total lipid content by the sample surface area.
